title: fix(dataset): add timeout to dataset import data download
body:
## Summary

`load_data` in `superset/commands/dataset/importers/v1/utils.py` downloads dataset data from a remote URI via `opener.open(data_uri)` with no timeout. A missing timeout means the socket can block forever if the remote host is unreachable or stalls mid-transfer, wedging the dataset import indefinitely.

This adds a sensible socket timeout to that call:

```python
DATA_URI_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT = 60  # seconds

data = opener.open(data_uri, timeout=DATA_URI_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT)
```

Minimal, single-file change; behavior is unchanged except that a hung download now fails after the timeout instead of blocking forever. This matches the timeout handling already present on the other outbound HTTP calls in `superset/` (e.g. `utils/csv.py`, `tasks/utils.py`).


Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/d472a685aa0a42e9a19eb0141561df28
Requested by: @Pintrue
